pricing.p_text.ai_video_generator_main_f: AI Video Generator (main film) + Trailer (social-ready) + Multilingual (for international family). Most-booked bundle.
pricing.p_text.aipowered_wedding_video_s: AI-powered wedding video services for couples worldwide.
pricing.p_text.all_major_credit_cards_vi: All major credit cards (via Stripe), PayPal, and bank transfer for projects over $1,000. Invoices are sent on delivery; payment is due within 14 days.
pricing.p_text.all_prices_in_usd_interna: All prices in USD. International payment accepted. EU/UK customers see equivalent pricing in local currency on the quote.
pricing.p_text.every_project_is_differen: Every project is different. A 5-minute VHS tape and a 3-hour 4K wedding film are not the same work. We quote based on footage length, complexity, and turnaround. The $9.9 starting price is the entry point for each service; the final quote reflects your project's actual scope.
pricing.p_text.every_project_is_quoted_i: Every project is quoted individually based on footage length, complexity, and turnaround.
pricing.p_text.family_tribute_honoring_a: Family Tribute (honoring a loved one) + Restoration (old footage from the same era). Often used for 30th / 40th / 50th anniversary videos.
pricing.p_text.most_couples_book_2_or_3_: Most couples book 2 or 3 services together — and we discount accordingly.
pricing.p_text.multilingual_2ndash3_lang: Multilingual (2–3 languages) + Family Message (remote relatives recorded separately) + Trailer (final 1-minute highlight).
pricing.p_text.never_we_charge_per_proje: Never. We charge per project. You'll know the exact price before we start — and the price won't change unless you add scope.
pricing.p_text.no_file_delivery_format_c: No. File delivery, format conversion, and 2 rounds of revisions are included in every project. The only time the price changes is if you ask for additional work after delivery.
pricing.p_text.no_hourly_billing_no_surp: No hourly billing. No surprise fees. The price you see is the price you pay — and every project includes 2 free revisions, 24-hour quote response, and 100% satisfaction guarantee.
pricing.p_text.or_email_us_directly.5a96: Or email us directly: order@weddingai.video
pricing.p_text.sofia_reads_every_form_wi: Sofia reads every form within 24 hours — usually within 4 hours during business days. No commitment, free consultation. Or browse the full service catalog to compare details.
pricing.p_text.sometimes_if_your_wedding: Sometimes. If your wedding serves a charitable cause (e.g. a vow-renewal fundraiser) or you have a tight story to tell, mention it in the form — we'll see what we can do.
pricing.p_text.trailer_cinematic_1ndash3: Trailer (cinematic 1–3 min) + Meme Generator (10 social clips) + Pet Wedding (funny opener). Optimized for different platforms.
pricing.p_text.vintage_restoration_paren: Vintage Restoration (parents' or grandparents' old footage) + Family Tribute (in-memory moments) + AI Video Generator (stills → film). Ideal for 30th / 40th / 50th anniversary films and family memory preservation.
pricing.p_text.yes_two_free_revisions_ar: Yes. Two free revisions are included with every service. If after revisions you're still not happy, we offer a full refund. We've processed over 500 projects and refunded fewer than 5.
pricing.p_text.google_serps_for_free_ai_: Google SERPs for "free AI wedding video maker" surface Canva, ZSky AI, Vidpex AI, and Pollo AI — all free, all with trade-offs. Here's what you actually get when you pay $9.9.
pricing.p_text.based_on_google_serp_for_: Based on Google SERP for "free AI wedding video maker no watermark" (Sep 2026) — Canva, ZSky AI, Vidpex AI, Pollo AI. Comparison shows typical trade-offs; specific competitor features may change.
